name: Coda
description: Productivity and project management: all-in-one doc platform combining documents, tables, automations and apps (rebranded as Superhuman Docs in 2026).
access_notes: The REST API is available free of charge to all users on free and paid workspaces; API tokens are generated self-serve from coda.io/account (tokens can be scoped read/write and restricted to specific docs/tables).
mcp_notes: Official vendor-hosted MCP server at https://coda.io/apis/mcp (public beta; OAuth 2 with PKCE or personal access token), now also at https://docs.superhuman.com/apis/mcp after the Superhuman Docs rebrand; documented in the official Superhuman help center. Composio has a CODA toolkit (API key auth, 110 tools, 4 triggers).
uncertainty_notes: Coda is rebranding to Superhuman Docs; docs now live on both coda.io and superhuman.com domains. The API only exposes docs/pages/tables/rows/controls (plus Packs), not org admin — breadth rated medium. Webhooks are inbound-only (automation trigger endpoints); there is no outbound webhook subscription API, so supports_webhooks is false for event notifications.

evidence.note: Official API reference: RESTful API at https://coda.io/apis/v1, 'available to all of our users free of charge, in both free and paid workspaces'; auth via Authorization: Bearer <api_token> from coda.io/account.
Official help article on the public API; webhook support is limited to inbound automation-trigger endpoints, no outbound webhook subscriptions documented.
Official help center: 'The Superhuman Docs MCP server is officially published at https://docs.superhuman.com/apis/mcp'; the earlier Coda MCP at https://coda.io/apis/mcp is still officially supported.
Official setup guide for connecting AI clients to the Coda/Superhuman Docs MCP.
Composio CODA toolkit: API_KEY auth, 110 tools, 4 triggers.
